**q25.** Engine: CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-house filter package `internal/filter` (`engine.go:24 NewEngine`, `parser.go`, `ir.go`, `render.go`, `schema.go`, `helpers.go`). Mechanism: `Engine.Compile` type-checks the CEL expression against a memo schema and lowers it to a dialect-agnostic `Condition` tree, then `renderer.Render` (`internal/filter/render.go`) emits dialect-specific SQL text plus bound args — chosen by `RenderOptions.Dialect` (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectMySQL`/`DialectPostgres`, e.g. `?` vs `$n` placeholders, `LIKE`/`memos_unicode_lower` vs `ILIKE`, `REGEXP` vs `~`) — which each driver appends to its WHERE clause through `filter.AppendConditions` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`).

```

memo_share      — DB-level FK ON DELETE CASCADE (store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108, mysql/LATEST.sql:108); note SQLite opens with _pragma=foreign_keys(0) (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53), so this cascade does not fire on SQLite

`reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but are not deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the Vite build output is copied to `server/router/frontend/dist` (`cd web && pnpm release`) and compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*`, then served by Echo's static middleware with an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed), `:41-59` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); invoked from `server/server.go` (frontend service registration).

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — started at server/server.go:162-171; RunOnce immediately, then Run() on a 12-hour time.Ticker (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27,30)
webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54 init(), driven by the asyncPostQueue channel (event-driven, not scheduled)
```
Unused infra note: `server/runner/memopayload` is **not** started as a background runner — only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from the memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`); its `Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) has no production caller. Likewise the full cron scheduler package `internal/scheduler` (`scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`, `middleware.go`) is referenced only by its own docs/tests — the server never instantiates it.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:151-176` (attached to the Connect transport at `:186`), with token state in `web/src/auth-state.ts` and proactive refresh in `web/src/hooks/useTokenRefreshOnFocus.ts`. Tokens: a short-lived JWT **access token** (15 min, `AccessTokenDuration`, kept in `localStorage`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`) and a **refresh token** (rotating, HTTP-only `Set-Cookie`, sent via `credentials: "include"`, exchanged by `AuthService.RefreshToken`); personal access tokens (`memos_pat_` prefix) are also accepted for API clients. Backend validation: package `server/auth` (`authenticator.go`, `token.go`, `extract.go`), driven through `NewAuthorizer` / `NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` and `connect_interceptors.go` (`v1.go:67,136`).

```
The first three converge on `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120` for delivery.
